body:
EXPLICIT ROUND from collab.

O1 — STANDOFF, YES. Canonical semantics must remain offsets/SpanSet support over StorySource.canonicalText, while source.txt preserves original bytes under the separate A3 intake identity. Inline markup may exist only as a declared-lossy report/export; it cannot become model identity, evidence coordinates, or the round-trip source.

O2 — TWO ROLE-SEPARATED ARTIFACTS UNDER ONE VERSIONED MANIFEST ENVELOPE. Keep the existing canonical StoryModelCodec artifact byte-owning its semantic role. Keep audit/acquisition/result state in a separate typed artifact so refusal or report failure never requires minting or rewriting a model JSON. The manifest binds both by role/schema/checksum and represents an absent semantic artifact through A5, not an empty file. This is one bundle and one envelope of identity, not one overloaded JSON document.

O3 — TWO VIEWS IN ONE SELF-CONTAINED HTML REPORT. The canonical text rail plus page-local lanes owns exact spans and local annotations. A second declared story-scale relation/hierarchy view owns causal, world-time, and other cross-page structure. Cross-page relations appear on the rail as paired portal endpoints plus a complete relation inventory; plain fragment links provide bidirectional navigation under the no-JavaScript rule. A single many-page overlay should not be the acceptance hypothesis. The remaining spike is usability/layout only: choose portal density, relation-family filtering as pre-rendered plates, pagination, print behavior, and level-of-detail thresholds. It is not a spike over whether graph structure needs a second projection.

Minimum O3 court: one relation crossing a page break, one discontinuous evidence support, one repeated endpoint identity, and one relation suppressed at a declared level of detail. Every rail portal and Atlas mark must resolve through stable Address/RelationId to the same evidence/status/provenance; removing either endpoint or inventory row must make lowering refuse. No color, absence of ink, or geometric distance may carry the missing semantics.

O4 — HTML IS A REPORT, NOT AN INTERCHANGE PARSER. StoryModelCodec owns decode -> Draft -> validate round-trip. HTML owes deterministic regeneration from exact model + ViewSpec + layout inputs, canonical-text twin equality, complete report receipt, pure HTML/CSS/offline behavior, accessibility, and no scientific inference. It does not owe parseHtml(render(model)) == model.

This affirms the epic without authorizing implementation. S1-S5 can become specification beads; S6 alone remains blocked on Stage 1b.
